start_urls_note: Primary enumeration is the bepress per-collection XML sitemap, which lists every volume, issue and article landing page in one document (no pagination). all_issues.html is a single unpaginated fallback listing all 537 issues.

metadata.journal_name: Journal of Criminal Law and Criminology
metadata.status_reason: Enumeration verified end to end on 2026-08-29 (7,389 sitemap URLs; 116 volumes / 537 issues / 6,735 article landing pages). PDF retrieval is blocked platform-wide: /cgi/viewcontent.cgi returns HTTP 403 from Cloudflare on every bepress host (see ACQUISITION_BACKLOG_2026-08-29.md). Not a JS challenge; not to be evaded.
metadata.status_evidence_ref: Article links on jclc.law.northwestern.edu/issues/ all point to scholarlycommons.law.northwestern.edu/jclc/volNN/issN/N

navigation.archive_path: jclc.law.northwestern.edu (WordPress shell, metadata only) -> every article links out to scholarlycommons.law.northwestern.edu/jclc/volN/issM/K -> Download anchor -> /cgi/viewcontent.cgi
navigation.pagination: none - bepress serves the whole collection in one sitemap.xml and one all_issues.html; there is no pager to follow and no first-page truncation risk
navigation.volume_range: vol 1 through vol 116 (current issue vol 116 iss 3)
navigation.notes: jclc.law.northwestern.edu is WordPress (Yoast) and is a front-end shell only: its /issues/ custom post type holds 6,585 metadata posts whose body links out to the Digital Commons backend. Its own sitemaps (issues-sitemap1..7 + articles-sitemap) are a useful metadata cross-check but carry no PDFs. Exception: /jclc-online/ (37 posts in articles-sitemap.xml) is web-only JCLC Online content that does NOT appear on Digital Commons and would need a separate WordPress pass. Robots on both hosts permit these paths; no Crawl-delay is declared on either. scholarlycommons robots disallows /do/ (blocks the OAI-PMH endpoint) - use the XML sitemap, not OAI.
